reason: Holds only when the migrations root is ./config/migrations (local.yml); default root is /etc/flipt/config/migrations. Agent meant repo layout, so refutation looks pedantic.
Pinned semconv v1.4.0 defines DBSystemCockroachdb, so cockroachdb is a standard db.system value there; claim states the opposite fact.
Key is required only under a direct map-lookup design; branching on url.Unaliased avoids it, so the unconditional 'must' overreaches.
Field-list part is right, but 'cannot be done manually' is wrong: the descriptor can be rebuilt via descriptorpb and re-marshaled into rawDesc.
Keeping updated/unknown entries regardless of plus/minus contradicts the requirement to return only requested +/- CVEs, each carrying a status.
globalthis.user.js limits itself to listed sites via @include, so not all other polyfills are global; one exception breaks the blanket claim.
getStatus and getPrivateRoomId are defined on usersAPI in src/api/users.js, not chatsAPI; claim names the wrong API object.
Reads 'no new interfaces' as 'no exported API changes', though existing APIs must change behavior. Verifier itself hedges on that reading, so doubtful.
isNumber(null) is false, so !isNumber(null) is true and the guard throws before parseInt runs; null is actually rejected.
Decoding keeps absent fields, but Load also runs Init/setDefault, writing absent dictionary fields; the 'only' leaves those writes out.
CockroachDB docs say a UNIQUE constraint cannot be dropped via DROP CONSTRAINT; its backing index must be dropped instead.
Guard checks uid <= 0, not presence; an undefined uid passes and reaches getPrivateRoomId, so presence is not verified.
TUI loads results via LoadScanResults, which skips *_diff.json files; it does not read pre-generated diff JSON.
editMessage, pinMessage, unpinMessage take mid and roomId, but deleteMessage and restoreMessage take only mid; pattern generalized to all five.
In the HTTP OpenAPI test the agent analyzed, the controller sets stop=39 before api.chats.list; stop=undefined is the wrong outcome.
Baseline calls getDiffCves(previous, current); the cited mode, plus and minus arguments do not exist in the call or signature.
Go's FlagSet.Visit visits only flags actually set, so an omitted bool flag is distinguishable from an explicit -flag=false.
With ExcludeNotFound, batchEvaluate continues past ErrNotFound and returns a nil error; the claim says it returns an error.
Issue lists the OCI Source interfaces as new interfaces, so claim misstates requirements; but they look like foreign flipt contamination, making the refutation doubtful.
Issue rejects only when no valid start, stop or page exists; perPage is optional, so the page-plus-perPage prerequisite is a wrong requirement.
Issue requires parse_version to return a normalized QVersionNumber; the proposed no-normalization behavior contradicts that requirement.
protoc-gen-go, not protoc itself, marshals and emits the raw descriptor; but 'generated by protoc' is common usage, so refutation seems pedantic.
QtWebEngine version often equals Qt version, but it is resolved separately and code handles mixed versions; identity is not general.
Postgres driver avoids the shim but locks with pg_advisory_lock; CockroachDB needs its own table-based locking driver, which the proposal leaves out.
Lookup does map to Postgres, but 'works as-is' omits distinct CockroachDB identification and the CockroachDB migration driver the issue requires.
Claims retaining is acceptable; verifier says consistency requirement forbids it. Doubtful: issue's earlyinit rule only needs compiled/runtime minimum checks.
Default-true flags work only when config.toml omits diffPlus/diffMinus; Load runs after flag parsing and can override an explicit -diff-plus=false.
Task defines only + and - statuses for requested new/resolved CVEs; an empty or '=' status introduces an unsupported third result category.
Raw forwarding leaves stop undefined for start+perPage requests since the API derives ranges only from page; needed range derivation is omitted.
Reconstructed parse_version is non-normalizing, contradicting the issue's normalized Qt-native requirement; 5.4 and 5.4.0 would stay unequal.
Issue's Actual Behavior says runtime checks use older approaches instead of QLibraryInfo.version(); the claim reverses its meaning.
Static, QString-taking, QVersionNumber-returning parts are right, but it leaves out Qt 5.15's optional int *suffixIndex output parameter.
start=0/stop=19 holds only when perPage is absent; a supplied perPage such as 50 yields stop=49 under the same conditions.
The Key() call lives in utils/cache/file_caches.go; image_cache.go's callback only calls Reader, so the claimed file is wrong.
Pinned semconv v1.4.0 package defines DBSystemCockroachdb = "cockroachdb"; the claimed absence of a CockroachDB constant is false.
Issue requires current-only CVEs marked '+' and a status on every diff CVE; claim wrongly deems unmarked not-found results acceptable.
Matches Math.trunc only for ordinary values; ToIntegerOrInfinity maps NaN and -0 to 0, while Math.trunc returns NaN and -0.
Load visits only direct Config fields, not CacheConfig's subfields. Quote meant Config's top-level fields, which is true; error came from normalization.
Injection also needs quirks enabled and name not skipped; the default skip list has js-string-replaceall, so not injected on all qualifying pages.
check_doc_changes fails only on refs/heads/master; on other refs, including pull requests, it exits 0 despite doc differences.
